notes: Starting estimates only. Validate density with a pilot and monitoring before production sign-off.

Frontline.label: Frontline worker
Frontline.description: Web or line-of-business app access over anything else; light browsing and data entry.

Standard.label: Standard office worker
Standard.description: Microsoft 365 apps (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Teams chat with typical multitasking.

Heavy.label: Heavy office worker
Heavy.description: Heavy Outlook/PowerPoint, frequent Teams meetings, many browser tabs or developer tools.
